value.name: Asha calls Devin about filing
value.description: Asha phones Devin, asks him to come to her apartment tonight, and says it concerns Tuesday's filing.
evidence: Asha said his name and then, before he could ask, told him she needed him at her apartment tonight, that it was about Tuesday's filing

value.name: Devin agrees to come later
value.description: Devin says he will come after he finishes the Hatcher exhibits.
evidence: until he said he'd come after he finished the Hatcher exhibits

value.name: Asha hides the corrected folder
value.description: Asha puts the top folder from the corrected stack into her briefcase, keeping the marked material out of sight.
evidence: Asha lifted the top folder off the stack, the red X still visible at the corner, and slid it into her briefcase on the chair beside her

value.name: Briefcase latch snaps shut
value.description: Asha closes the briefcase with a sharper-than-intended click that echoes through the kitchen.
evidence: The latch clicked once, sharper than she meant it, and the sound carried in the kitchen the way a closing door did in an empty house

value.name: Rosa asks what happens next
value.description: From the doorway, Rosa asks Asha what they do now, signaling tension after the phone call.

value.name: Asha withholds an answer
value.description: Asha keeps her hand on the briefcase and does not respond to Rosa's question.
evidence: Asha kept her hand on the briefcase a moment longer
and did not answer her yet

value.name: Rosa slides the phone back
value.description: Rosa approaches the table and quietly pushes the phone toward Asha without fully touching her.
evidence: Rosa took the two steps to the table and, without quite touching Asha, slid the phone off the corrected stack toward her

value.name: Asha turns to face Rosa
value.description: Asha releases the briefcase handle, exhales, and looks up at Rosa instead of at the phone.
evidence: Asha let go of the briefcase handle and let her breath out, slow enough that Rosa would hear it, and looked up at her instead of at the screen
